description: Create a designed, full-colour Word (.docx) report from Colour Memory records. Use this whenever the user asks for a document, report, write-up, handout or Word file built from archive findings, instead of writing a plain document yourself. Pass the records by the record_id or slug exactly as archive_search (or another tool) returned them, grouped into sections with a heading and optional narrative. Colour Memory resolves every record itself and draws its name, date, place, notes, evidence grade and source from the archive: no evidence field is accepted from the caller, and an unknown or ambiguous reference refuses the whole document (REPORT_RECORD_NOT_RESOLVED). Colour is shown honestly: a filled chip only where the record has a hex, always with where that hex comes from; otherwise the colour appears as the source's own words in an empty frame. Narrative you write is printed in blocks labelled as interpretation, never as archive evidence. Returns a signed, time-limited download link (delivery='url', default) or the file inline (delivery='base64'). Limits: 8 sections, 6 records per section.

narrative.description: Your own short paragraphs for this section; printed as labelled interpretation.

records.description: record_id or slug values exactly as Colour Memory returned them.

name: archive_report_document

outputSchema.description: Structured JSON response. Shape varies by tool; most return an 'ok' boolean plus a 'result' or 'results' field with the tool's data payload.

title: Designed Word Report
